title: Bake Squad
overview: Expert bakers elevate desserts with next-level ideas and epic execution. Now the battle is on to win over clients in need of very special sweets.

title: Big Tree City
overview: A team of animal heroes with special skills and speedy vehicles work together to keep Big Tree City safe and solve the town's trickiest problems.

title: Country Comfort
overview: When an up-and-coming young country singer accepts a job as a nanny with a musical family, she finds the bond she's always missed.

title: Dragons: Rescue Riders: Hunt for the Golden Dragon
overview: It's the treasure hunt of a lifetime for the Rescue Riders, who must race to find a precious golden dragon egg and protect it from evil pirates.

title: Dragons: Rescue Riders: Secrets of the Songwing
overview: When a musical dragon with a beautiful voice hypnotizes the dragons and people of Huttsgalor, the Rescue Riders have to find a way to break the spell.

title: Easy-Bake Battle: The Home Cooking Competition
overview: Talented home cooks put their skills and creativity to the test making fast and easy dishes that are wildly delicious — and worthy of a big cash prize.

title: Elmo and Mark Rober's Merry Giftmas
overview: Elmo and his Sesame Street friends work with former NASA engineer turned YouTube star Mark Rober to make special presents for a Merry Giftmas exchange.

title: Little Baby Bum: Music Time
overview: Come join the fun at the magical Music Time preschool, where every day is an adventure filled with kid-friendly songs — and lots of learning!

title: Little Witch Academia
overview: When she was a little girl, Atsuko "Akko" Kagari saw a magic show performed by a witch named Shiny Chariot.  From that day on she wanted to be just like her.  Enrolling at Luna Nova Magical Academy and having no magical background, can she become a witch like her idol Shiny Chariot?

title: Mighty Express: Train Trouble
overview: A sneaky duo has tricked the trains and taken over Mission Station! Can Flicker flex his skills on the tracks to rescue his friends and save the day?

title: Oggy Oggy
overview: Join adorable kitten Oggy and his cast of cat pals in a bright and colorful kitty world. They're always on the go for fun times and fantastic adventures!

title: Ridley Jones
overview: Curious kid Ridley and her friends protect the Museum of Natural History’s treasures and keep its magical secret safe: Everything comes alive at night!

title: Shaun the Sheep: The Flight Before Christmas
overview: Shaun's seasonal excitement turns to dismay when a farmhouse raid to get bigger stockings for the flock inadvertently leads to Timmy going missing. Can Shaun get Timmy back before he becomes someone else’s present?

title: Spirit Riding Free: Pony Tales
overview: Find the fun and adventure of "Spirit Riding Free" in this mix of music videos and short episodes featuring Lucky and all of her friends!

title: Spirit Riding Free: Spirit of Christmas
overview: Lucky and her friends venture into town on Christmas Eve in an attempt to fulfill their holiday plans. But when distractions lead to delays, they must figure out how to get home in time for Christmas in the middle of a serious snowstorm!

title: StoryBots: Answer Time
overview: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

title: Strawberry Shortcake: Berry in the Big City
overview: Aspiring baker Strawberry Shortcake arrives in Big Apple City to get her big break — and have flan-tastic adventures with her new berry besties!

title: Thomas & Friends: The Christmas Letter Express
overview: Percy discovers a child's letter to Santa Claus forgotten at the bottom of his mail van on Christmas Eve, but he is determined to make things right, even if that means tracking down Mr. Claus himself! With help from Thomas and his friends, Percy travels through dazzling parades, sweet-smelling gingerbread bakes, and snowflake flurries on a quest to deliver the letter to Santa and make a child’s Christmas Wish come true.

title: Trolls Holiday
overview: When the eternally optimistic Poppy, queen of the Trolls, learns that the Bergens no longer have any holidays on their calendar, she enlists the help of Branch and the rest of the gang on a delightfully quirky mission to fix something that the Bergens don't think is broken.

title: Holly Hobbie
overview: Holly's a 13-year-old singer-songwriter who's got her best friends and close-knit family by her side, but she's dreaming of ways to save the world - even if it's starting in her own backyard.

title: Super Monsters: Once Upon a Rhyme
overview: From Goldilocks to Hansel and Gretel, the Super Monsters reimagine classic fairy tales and favorite nursery rhymes with a musical, magical spin!
